correctness.rationale: In F_{c,d}(x,y)=(y,-x+f_{c,d}(y)) mod2 with 0<c<2, h=2-c, only three-branch word 111 gives identity derivative for F³ off null branch seams. Hence all positive-area period-three points have x,y,z in upper branch and x+y+z=d+c+2k. Their independent (x,y) polygon sections of (0,h)^3 have exact area B_h(d-2c+2k), so Haar fraction is one-quarter sum. Mod-two open interval of length 3h contains every shift residue iff 3h>2; c=4/3 zero shift included. At c=1 periodized quadratic gives min1/16, max3/16. Independent exact rational area/three-step checks confirm 1,190 strict periodic points and branch formula; general all-parameter proof is geometric.
